brand.name: Open Sesame
brand.kicker: A trusted door to your work

login.title: Open the door!
login.description: Sign in to continue to your workspace.

success.title: You're in.
success.description: Your workspace is ready. Taking you there now.

auth.registerDescription: Set up your account to open the door to your workspace.

mfa.title: Verify it's you.
mfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app or the one we just emailed you. You can also use a recovery code.
mfa.emailHint: Email codes expire after 5 minutes. Didn't get one?
mfa.signInAgain: Sign in again to get a new code

verify.title: Check your inbox.
verify.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 5 minutes.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.notVerified: Your account isn't verified yet. We just sent you a new code.
verify.verified: Your account is verified. Sign in to continue.

reset.title: Forgot your key?
reset.description: Enter your account email and we will send you a 6-digit code to set a new password.
reset.confirmDescription: If an account exists for {email}, a 6-digit code is on its way. It expires in 5 minutes.
reset.done: Your password was reset. Sign in with your new password.

errors.request: Unable to send the reset code. Please try again.
errors.confirm: Unable to reset your password. Please try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

errors.signInRequired: Enter your email and password to continue.
errors.registerRequired: Fill in every field to continue.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password that meets every requirement and doesn't include your name or a common word.
errors.signIn: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password.
errors.register: Unable to create your account. Please try again.
errors.otpRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your email.
errors.verify: Unable to verify your account. Please try again.
errors.resend: Unable to resend the code. Please try again.
errors.resendLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.mfaCodeRequired: Enter a verification or recovery code.
errors.mfaVerify: Unable to verify your code. Please try again.

oauth.title: {app} wants access.
oauth.description: Review what this app is asking for before you open the door.
oauth.finePrint: Allowing sends you to {host}. {app} will use this access under its own terms; you can revoke it at any time.

client.unverifiedHint: Open Sesame couldn't confirm who publishes this app. Only continue if you trust it.
client.inactive: This app has been disabled and can't be authorized.

oauth.scopesNarrowed: {app} asked for more, but is only allowed the permissions above.

openid.title: Sign you in
openid.description: Confirm your identity with Open Sesame.

email.title: See your email address
email.description: The email address on your account.

offline_access.title: Stay connected
offline_access.description: Keep access while you're away, until you revoke it.

custom.title: Use the "{scope}" permission
custom.description: A custom permission defined by this app.

cancelled.title: Request cancelled.
cancelled.description: {app} didn't get access. You can close this tab.

invalid.title: This request can't be completed.
invalid.unsupportedResponseType: The app sent an unsupported response type. Contact the app's developer.
invalid.missingClient: The app didn't identify itself. Contact the app's developer.
invalid.invalidRedirect: The app sent an invalid return address. Contact the app's developer.
invalid.missingState: The request is missing its security state. Contact the app's developer.
invalid.invalidChallengeMethod: The app used an unsupported PKCE method. Contact the app's developer.

clientsCard.title: OAuth clients
clientsCard.description: Register apps that sign users in with Open Sesame.

scopesCard.title: Scopes
scopesCard.description: Manage the permissions clients can request.

profileCard.title: Profile and security
profileCard.description: Your details, password, two-factor authentication and sessions.

scopes.stale: No longer available. Uncheck to remove it.
scopes.title: Permissions.
scopes.description: Scopes clients can be allowed to request. Descriptions are shown to users on the consent screen.
scopes.name: Name
scopes.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers and : . _ - only, up to 100 characters.
scopes.descriptionRequired: Enter a description users will understand.

deactivate.title: Deactivate scope
deactivate.message: Clients can no longer be given "{name}". Clients already using it keep it until they are edited.

errors.load: Unable to load the available scopes.

clients.title: Your apps.
clients.description: Apps registered here can ask users to sign in with Open Sesame.
clients.search: Search by name or client ID
clients.createDescription: You'll get a client ID, and a secret for confidential apps.
clients.noScopes: None. This app can't request any permissions yet.
clients.secretHidden: The client secret is stored hashed and can't be shown again. Rotate it if it's lost.
clients.noSecret: Public clients have no secret; they must use PKCE.

empty.title: No clients yet.
empty.description: Register your first app to start using Open Sesame for sign-in.

confidential.title: Confidential
confidential.description: Server-side apps that can keep a secret.

public.title: Public
public.description: SPAs and mobile apps. No secret, PKCE required.

grants.authorization_code: Users sign in through the consent screen.
grants.refresh_token: Keep users signed in with rotating refresh tokens.
grants.client_credentials: Machine-to-machine access with the client secret.

secret.title: Copy your client secret now.
secret.warning: This is the only time it will be shown. Store it somewhere safe, such as your server's secret manager.
secret.label: Client secret

integration.title: Integration
integration.description: Send users to this URL to start sign-in. Replace the placeholders with values your app generates per request.

rotate.title: Rotate secret
rotate.description: Issue a new secret. The current one stops working immediately.
rotate.message: Apps using the current secret will fail until you deploy the new one. Continue?

deactivate.title: Deactivate client
deactivate.description: Blocks new sign-ins and revokes every refresh token issued to this app.
deactivate.message: Every user signed in through this app will be logged out and must sign in again after reactivation. Continue?

activate.title: Reactivate client
activate.description: Allow sign-ins again. Previously revoked tokens stay revoked.
activate.message: The app will be able to sign users in again. Continue?

form.name: App name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the app.
form.typeLocked: The client type can't be changed after creation.
form.redirectsHint: Exact URLs users return to after signing in. HTTPS, http://localhost, or a custom app scheme.
form.redirectRequired: Enter a URL or remove this row.
form.redirectInvalid: Use https://, http://localhost, or a custom scheme, without a #fragment.
form.redirectsRequired: Add at least one redirect URI for the authorization code flow.
form.grantsRequired: Choose at least one grant type.
form.scopesHint: Permissions this app may request. Requests for anything else are rejected.
form.pkceHint: Recommended. Protects the authorization code if it's intercepted.
form.ttlInvalid: Use a whole number of seconds greater than 0.
form.ttlHint: Leave blank to use the server defaults.
form.ttlEditHint: Leaving a field blank keeps its current value.

profile.title: Your profile.
profile.description: Update your details and keep your key safe.

account.title: Account details
account.unverifiedHint: Your email isn’t verified yet. Enter the code we sent to finish setting it up.
account.emailChangeHint: We’ll send a 6-digit code to the new address, and your account stays unverified until you enter it.

emailDialog.title: Change your email?
emailDialog.message: We’ll send a verification code to {email}. Until you enter it, your account stays unverified and signing in will ask for the code.

password.title: Password
password.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from your current one.
password.changed: Password updated. Use it next time you sign in.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Add an extra layer of security with an authenticator app or codes sent to your email.
mfa.statusHint: The profile API does not report MFA status yet. You can set it up or try disabling it with a current code.
mfa.emailSetup: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to turn on two-factor authentication.
mfa.emailSent: A new code was sent to {email}.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this setup key manually:
mfa.recoveryDescription: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app or email. They are shown only now.
mfa.disableConfirm: Enter a current authenticator or email code to disable two-factor authentication.

errors.qr: Unable to generate the setup QR code. Use the setup key instead.
errors.sendCode: Unable to send the code. Please try again.

errors.emailTaken: That email is already used by another account.

sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.
